test_title: PYST 24: RRB NTPC Graduate Level CBT-I - Reasoning (Held On: 16 Jun, 2025 Shift 1)
subject: reasoning
question:
Vinod starts from point A and drives 8 km towards the west. He then takes a left turn, drives 6 km, turns left and drives 12 km. He then takes a left turn and drives 11 km. He takes a final left turn, drives 4 km and stops at point P. How far (shortest distance) and towards which direction should he drive in order to reach point A again? (All turns are

90-degree turns only unless specified.)
solution:
Given:

Vinod starts from point A and drives 8 km towards the west.

He then takes a left turn, drives 6 km, turns left and drives 12 km.

He then takes a left turn and drives 11 km.

He takes a final left turn, drives 4 km and stops at point P. 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/8dbc68313b16205286f56bfedc24a700cd26f639c92dd3160e86f3b42dd1833d.png] 

Thus, Vinod should drive 5 km in the south direction in order to reach point A again.

Hence, **"Option 3"** is the correct answer.
